summary: Standing now folds since a row-id watermark, not the last 40 rows: every fold reads everything that arrived since the last fold (capped at 200 rows), and a conversation that passes 40 messages between tags no longer loses the middle.
details: Each conversation's standing position carries last_folded_row_id — the audit row the last fold read up to. Every fold (tagged turn or not) reads since_including_nora(after_id=watermark, limit=fold_batch=200), including Nora's own rows, and advances the watermark in the same write as the position.

Folds are now triggered event-driven: every message spawns a check that folds when the accumulator reaches 200, serialized per conversation through the existing slot queue. Cold-start and backlog conversations roll up in batches (200+200+100), bounded at 5 folds per trigger.

The [standing] window key is gone; replaced by fold_batch (200), event_enabled (true), rollup_max_folds (5). Rollup folds do not increment the row's fold_count and are counted on nora_standing_rollup_folds_total; nora_standing_event_folds_total and the nora_standing_watermark_gap gauge are new.
Re-derivation (rebuild) re-reads the same stretch and does not advance the watermark.
